name: degraded-fallback-requires-host-availability-proof
title: Require host availability proof before degraded single-host review fallback
description: Fix Proof-or-stop bug: review_escalation_fallback_set currently accepts eligibility=single-host-environment based on operator prose without mechanically proving that fewer than two canonical host CLIs are available. Add fresh host availability evidence for codex, claude, and agy; reject single-host degraded fallback when two or more independent hosts are executable; make DONE/review assurance gates reject degraded 3x1 fallback records that are not bound to fresh host availability evidence unless the fallback is explicit-human-approval.
